_help: Act 3, after the riverboat is destroyed: stranded on the bank with the Americans (race_step 5, recognized_bandits). Walk with them (walked_with_americans) or alone. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: The boat's burning in the shallows. Everyone who made it is on the bank, soaked, counting heads.

whit.speaker: whitfield
whit.line: My boat! Well, Hamdi's boat. Those weren't river pirates, pal. Pirates take things. They just wanted it gone.

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: They waited until we were in the narrows. Clever. I'd like to meet whoever gave the orders.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: We lost kit, not people. That's the right way round. Let's keep it that way.

r_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
r_eleanor.line: My notebooks went into the river. I can remember most of it. Most of it.

r_farid.speaker: farid
r_farid.line: Half our stores are at the bottom of the Nile. I will need to buy camels at the next village, at thieves' prices.

choice.speaker: whitfield
choice.line: Long walk from here. We could walk it together. Safety in numbers.

choices.label: Walk with the Americans
choices.line: Together, then. Until we get there.

choices.label: Go on alone
choices.line: Thanks, but we'll make our own way.

together.speaker: whitfield
together.line: Swell. And our bet still stands, by the way. We're both starting from the same mud.

alone.speaker: whitfield
alone.line: Your funeral. See you at the finish line.
